question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage involves the **bursting of firecrackers, which typically produces smoke.**
 
• **"Smoke" **is the** most appropriate **option as it describes the cloud produced by the firecrackers accurately.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is** 'smoke.'**
 
• Hence, the correct sentence from the passage is **"****The video clip showed loud bangs of firecrackers, lights and clouds of smoke__ along with the echo of the ringing temple bells,......"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options like **"air," "water," and "fire" do not fit **well in describing the cloud produced by bursting firecrackers.

 
• **Air: **Refers to the gases around us, not a specific byproduct of firecrackers.
 
• **Water:** Not produced by firecrackers.
 
• **Fire: **While related to firecrackers, "fire" itself is not the cloud-like byproduct referred to in the passage.
